sql.processStep.getAllForCompany: select ps.id, ps.process_step_name, ps.company_id, ps.archived, ps.date_created, ps.date_modified, ps.created_by_id, ps.modified_by_id from flow.process_step ps where ps.company_id = :companyId and ps.archived is not true order by ps.process_step_name
sql.processStep.get: select ps.id, ps.process_step_name, ps.company_id, ps.archived, ps.date_created, ps.date_modified, ps.created_by_id, ps.modified_by_id, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(links))) FROM ( SELECT psl.id, psl.link_id as "linkId", psl.created_by_id as "createdById", psl.modified_by_id as "modifiedById", l.link, l.url, psl.archived FROM flow.process_step_link psl inner join flow.link l on l.id = psl.link_id WHERE psl.process_step_id = ps.id AND psl.archived is not true) links), '[]') AS "links", coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(attachmentTypes))) FROM ( SELECT psat.id, psat.attachment_type_id as "attachmentTypeId", psat.created_by_id as "createdById", psat.modified_by_id as "modifiedById", at.attachment_type as "attachmentType", psat.archived FROM flow.process_step_attachment_type psat inner join flow.attachment_type at on at.id = psat.attachment_type_id WHERE psat.process_step_id = ps.id AND psat.archived is not true) attachmentTypes), '[]') AS "attachmentTypes", coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(cfGroups))) FROM ( SELECT cfg.id, cfg.group_name as "groupName", cfg.event_type_id as "eventTypeId", et.event_type as "eventType", cot.object_type_id as "objectTypeId", cot.id as "companyObjectTypeId", cfg.archived, cfg.group_order as "groupOrder", cfg.process_step_id as "processStepId", coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(customFields))) FROM ( SELECT cfga.id, cfga.custom_field_group_id as "customFieldGroupId", cfga.custom_field_id as "customFieldId", cfga.ancillary_custom_field_group_assignment_id as "ancillaryCustomFieldGroupAssignmentId", cfga.field_order as "fieldOrder", cfga.archived, cf.field_name as "fieldName" FROM flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga inner join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfga.custom_field_id WHERE cfga.custom_field_group_id = cfg.id AND cfg.archived is not true union all SELECT cfga.id, cfga.custom_field_group_id as "customFieldGroupId", cfga.custom_field_id as "customFieldId", cfga.ancillary_custom_field_group_assignment_id as "ancillaryCustomFieldGroupAssignmentId", cfga.field_order as "fieldOrder", cfga.archived, cf.field_name as "fieldName" FROM flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga inner join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga2 on cfga2.id = cfga.ancillary_custom_field_group_assignment_id inner join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfga2.custom_field_id WHERE cfga.custom_field_group_id = cfg.id AND cfga.archived is not true ORDER by "fieldOrder") customFields), '[]') AS "customFields" FROM flow.custom_field_group cfg inner join flow.company_object_type cot on cot.id = cfg.company_object_type_id left join flow.event_type et on et.id = cfg.event_type_id WHERE cfg.process_step_id = ps.id AND cfg.archived is not true) cfGroups), '[]') AS custom_field_groups, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(workQueueTypes))) FROM ( SELECT pswqt.id, pswqt.work_queue_type_id as "workQueueTypeId", pswqt.process_step_id as "processStepId", pswqt.archived FROM flow.process_step_work_queue_type pswqt WHERE pswqt.process_step_id = ps.id AND pswqt.archived is not true) workQueueTypes), '[]') AS "workQueueTypes" from flow.process_step ps where ps.id = :id
sql.processStep.delete: update flow.process_step set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.processStep.update: update flow.process_step set modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now(), process_step_name = :name where id = :id;
sql.processStep.insert: insert into flow.process_step (company_id, process_step_name, created_by_id) values (:companyId, :name, :createdById)
sql.processStep.updateWorkQueueType: update flow.process_step_work_queue_type set modified_by_id = :userId, date_modified = now(), archived = :archived where id = :id;
sql.processStep.insertWorkQueueType: insert into flow.process_step_work_queue_type (process_step_id, work_queue_type_id, created_by_id) values (:processStepId, :workQueueTypeId, :userId)
sql.processStep.getWorkQueueTypesForStep: select id, work_queue_type_id, process_step_id, archived from flow.process_step_work_queue_type where process_step_id = :processStepId and archived is not true
sql.processStep.getParentObjects: select * from flow.process_step where company_id = :companyId and archived is not true order by process_step_name
sql.processStep.getParentObjectsIncludingTyp: select ps.id, ps.process_step_name as name, true as is_process_step from flow.process_step ps where ps.company_id = :companyId and ps.archived is not true union all select ot.id, ot.object_type as name, false as is_process_step from flow.company_object_type cot inner join flow.object_type ot on ot.id = cot.object_type_id where cot.company_id = :companyId and (ot.flow_type_id = 1 OR ot.flow_type_id = 3) and cot.archived is not true order by name
sql.processStep.getSchedulableProcessSteps: select distinct ps.id, ps.process_step_name, ps.company_id, ps.archived, ps.date_created, ps.date_modified, ps.created_by_id, ps.modified_by_id from flow.process_step ps inner join flow.custom_field_group cfg on cfg.process_step_id = ps.id and cfg.schedulable is true where ps.company_id = :companyId and ps.archived is not true order by ps.process_step_name
